Description
Rare opportunity to rent a brand-new laneway house in prime Point Grey! This bright and spacious 3-bedroom, 3-full-bathroom home offers over 1,000 sq. ft. of living space, a south-facing private entrance, modern open-concept kitchen with high-end appliances and full-height wood cabinetry, solid hardwood floors, central air conditioning, and in-suite laundry. Furnishing is optional. Located in a quiet and desirable neighborhood, within walking distance to Lord Byng Secondary School and just a 5-minute drive to UBC. A perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience!
